attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), built a local apk repository from packages fetched to local disk storage, served it over HTTP via darkhttpd bound to the node's own IP, then made the usual remote repo (dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org) unreachable via a /etc/hosts blackhole entry, and successfully installed the mtr package (plus its jansson dependency) using only the local repository while the remote was confirmed unreachable. Restored normal repo/hosts config afterward, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and health, issued a delayed reboot so the ack returned first, polled until node1 came back, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the installed package, local repo artifacts (byte-identical via md5), and restored remote-repo reachability all survived the restart.
